name: TinyChat
author: Awe
description: A small chatbot that runs on the calculator itself, with no connection. Ask it questions, chat, or get jokes. Maths, primes and unit conversions are calculated exactly.

variants.label: Small
variants.description: 2.1M-parameter model. Leaves room for other apps.

variants.label: Full
variants.description: 3.7M-parameter model. Better answers, takes most of the space.
